style: Fast premium product motion with tactile real-app cards, clean editorial labels, soft dimensional shadows, and one accumulating-card motif. Deep plum carries the app world; ivory and gold open the final brand frame. Energetic and polished, never frantic.
shot_brief: Four real Balance app cards arrive one by one and remain as a growing physical stack: quiz, community, weekly step-by-step progress, then workouts. Each interaction earns a terse editorial verb and a tactile click. At 6.55 seconds the full stack becomes the only pattern interrupt, tightening and compressing until its rectangular mass scale-swaps into the circular Balance mark. The final ivory brand frame holds the logo, 'Balance, Fitness Gamified', and 'Join Balance' long enough to register. No narration; sparse interface clicks and transition whooshes carry the rhythm.

customize.reuse: Use logo-outro for 7.65-10.00, replacing its logo, tagline, URL pill, palette, and timings. Borrow caption-editorial-emphasis for the four feature verbs and shimmer-sweep only for the workout completion accent. Hand-author only the preceding app-card accumulation because no catalog block covers a four-screen product montage.

motion.card_entry: scale_punch from 0.82 with y=120, opacity=0, duration=0.42, ease=back.out(1.45); previous card eases to its resting stack offset over 0.34s
motion.interaction: scale_pulse the touched control for 0.18s, add an 18px radial accent flash, then hold the readable app state for at least 0.55s
motion.feature_label: caption-editorial-emphasis word_reveal over 0.22s; gold underline_sweep over 0.24s; fade_out 0.18s before the next card arrives
motion.stack_compress: From 6.55-7.38, cards snap into exact registration while scaling from 1 to 0.24 and rotating to 0 degrees with power4.inOut; preserve visible colored edges until the last 0.12s
motion.logo_swap: At 7.38-7.82 apply rules/scale-swap-transition: card stack scales through 0.18 while the raster logo mask-reveals from scale 0.72 to 1 with a soft gold glow bloom; no SVG path draw
motion.final_lockup: Logo hold_breath at 1.012 scale; tagline fade_blur + word_reveal; CTA pill scale_grow; a restrained 0.55s shimmer-sweep crosses the CTA once

transitions.between_product_cards: No full-frame transition; the incoming card overtakes the existing stack on a diagonal 24px parallax, maintaining the accumulation motif.
transitions.pattern_interrupt: At 6.55 the card entries stop, the plum background opens to ivory through a circular mask centered on the compressing stack, and the stack becomes the logo. This is the sole structural pattern interrupt.
transitions.end: Clean hold from 9.48-10.00; no exit animation.

timeline.visual: Deep-plum field. Quiz card punches into the hero frame. At 0.35 the 'Athletic & Strong' answer compresses and flashes green; LEARN appears below. Card remains readable, then shifts into the back-left stack position.

Community card overtakes from lower right while the quiz remains as a visible edge. At 1.90 the Challenge Friend region pulses; CONNECT appears and underlines in gold. The card settles into the growing stack.

Character/Home capture arrives. Crop anchors on the Today/Week progress area while the avatar remains partially visible above. Native overlay rows labeled 1, 2, 3 tick on at 3.40, 3.78, and 4.12; PROGRESS appears at the final tick.

Movement card arrives frontmost. At 4.88 Today's Workout pulses, then a compact completion badge and check draw on at 6.05 with a single shimmer sweep; TRAIN appears. All four card edges are now visible.
The accumulated cards align, compress, and lose their offsets. The background changes only here: a circular ivory reveal expands from the stack as it scale-swaps into the Balance logo.
Logo-outro hero frame. Logo settles at 7.82, tagline enters at 8.45, and the Join Balance pill enters at 9.25. CTA shimmer ends by 9.48; lockup holds clean to frame 300.

audio.music: none_required; preserve headroom for an editor-added compact electronic bed
